🔵 [classify-terminal-order] CUT/FOLLOW-UP In classifyFullDiffReviewFault the new attempt_budget_exhausted terminal check sits after the gate_transient regex on fullDiff.reason; if a non-panel station surfaces a transient sibling's reason while another seat is exhausted, the fault classifies transient rather than terminal. Bounded anyway because each retry charges the remaining seats' attempts (budget 3), and the panel-station path is covered by the budgetFailure override in validateFinalPanelReceipt plus the over-budget test; moving the receipt-scan above the regex is a one-line hardening, not a blocker.
🔵 [live-packet-hash-branch] CUT/FOLLOW-UP The in-process replay fixture leaves sharedPacket null, so the expect.packetHash vs stored packet_hash comparison in deriveReusableOutcome is never exercised; the changed-packet control is enforced via input_binding (diff/spec digests in the artifact path), which satisfies the spec. A cross-process --resume smoke that confirms the live packet_hash is stable between runs would prove reuse actually fires in production; admission of a REVIEWING campaign is unit A's, so excluded here.
🔵 [reuse-skips-requalification] CUT/FOLLOW-UP A reused seat returns before finalPanelSeatQualified runs, so a seat that lost qualification between runs still contributes its stored verdict. Seat tuple, station, campaign and binding are all re-checked and the verdict was produced by a qualified seat at the time; acceptable for this version.
